# An A/B Test Pipeline

Build a pipeline that compares two variants — two alerting strategies for
disaster response, or two sampling protocols for the field survey — with a
permutation test and a bootstrap confidence interval for the effect size. A
distinct kind of analysis: experimentation and inference.

-   The null hypothesis is "no real difference"; shuffling labels simulates it.
-   A p-value is how often shuffles look as extreme as the real data.
-   The bootstrap puts a confidence interval around an effect size.
-   Simulated inference replaces closed-form math we may not know.
